verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (390 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0557).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0024 (t=0.2) vs placebo 0.0033 (t=0.34). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
